parole.testo: Borrowed from Low German Knuust, from Middle Low German knūst. Compare Dutch knoest and knuist. Possibly from Proto-Indo-European *ǵénus (“cheek, jaw, chin”) and its synonymous derivative *ǵn̥h₂dʰ(h₁)-.
